# GHG Protocol

> The GHG Protocol provides comprehensive guidance and training resources for measuring and managing greenhouse gas emissions across organizations and supply chains.

GHG Protocol offers an online learning platform with a knowledge base and training resources to help organizations implement standardized greenhouse gas accounting and reporting methodologies. The platform includes course access support, FAQs, and e-learning materials for users of their Learning Management System.

## Key Topics

- GHG Protocol
- Greenhouse Gas Emissions
- Learning Management System
- Online Training
- Knowledge Base
- Course Access
- E-learning Support
- FAQ
- Emissions Accounting
- GHG Reporting

## Online Training & Learning

- [GHG Protocol Online Training Knowledge Base](https://kb.ghgprotocol.org/): Knowledge base and FAQ for GHG Protocol online training LMS with course access support and e-learning resources
